question: Emily Henry's novel about two rival writers competing to pen a biography of a notorious heiress is titled as:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Great Big Beautiful Life.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• 
 
*Great Big Beautiful Life* is a contemporary romance novel by Emily Henry, a bestselling author known for her witty and emotionally rich storytelling.

 
 
• 
 
The plot follows two rival writers, **Daphne Vincent** and **Miles Nowak**, competing to secure the rights to write the biography of a notorious heiress, **Margaret Ives**.

 
 
• 
 
Published on **April 1, 2025**, the book has created buzz for its mix of sharp humor and heartfelt drama.

 
 
• 
 
The narrative shifts between glamorous city backdrops and intimate personal moments, exploring themes of ambition, truth, and the complexities of love in competitive creative circles.

 
 
• 
 
Early reviews predict it will be a bestseller, praising its dynamic characters and layered, engaging storyline.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Emily Henry**

 
 
• Emily Henry is a New York Times bestselling author, known for her works in contemporary romance and fiction genres.
 
• Some of her other notable works include **Beach Read** (2020) and **People We Meet on Vacation** (2021).
 
• Her books often feature complex, relatable characters and explore themes of love, self-discovery, and personal growth.
 
 
 
• **Contemporary Romance Genre**
 
 
• This genre focuses on love stories set in modern times, often involving relatable characters and realistic settings.
 
• It is characterized by themes of personal growth, emotional connections, and overcoming obstacles in relationships.
 
• Authors like Emily Henry, Christina Lauren, and Colleen Hoover are prominent figures in this genre.
 
 
 
• **Notorious Heiress Biographies**
 
 
• Biographies of heiresses often explore themes of wealth, privilege, scandal, and societal expectations.
 
• Such stories have captivated audiences due to their blend of glamour and intrigue.
 
• Examples include works on figures like Gloria Vanderbilt and Barbara Hutton, whose lives were marked by both fortune and public scrutiny.
 
 
 
• **Reception of Book Lovers**
 
 
• The novel has received critical acclaim for its witty dialogue and heartfelt storytelling.
 
• It appeals to fans of romance and literary fiction, making it a favorite among book clubs and casual readers alike.
 
• Emily Henry’s writing style is often praised for blending humor with emotional depth, creating memorable characters and narratives.
